title: Prescribed Fourier kernel on the diagonal
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of an $n$-element coordinate set, and let $a\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The prescribed Fourier kernel associated with $\mathcal F$, evaluated at $(a,a)$, equals $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of an $n$-element coordinate set
